sentences.pt: No sábado de manhã, o céu de São Paulo estava cinza.
sentences.en: On Saturday morning, the sky over São Paulo was gray.

sentences.pt: Larissa olhou pela janela e viu muitas nuvens escuras.
sentences.en: Larissa looked out the window and saw many dark clouds.

sentences.pt: Ela queria passear no parque com o namorado, Diego.
sentences.en: She wanted to go for a walk in the park with her boyfriend, Diego.

sentences.pt: A previsão do tempo dizia: chuva forte à tarde e temperatura de 15 graus.
sentences.en: The weather forecast said: heavy rain in the afternoon and a temperature of 15 degrees.

sentences.pt: "Que pena!", disse Larissa.
sentences.en: "What a pity!" said Larissa.

sentences.pt: Diego respondeu: "Não tem problema. A gente pode ir ao museu."
sentences.en: Diego answered: "No problem. We can go to the museum."

sentences.pt: Eles pegaram o metrô e chegaram ao museu antes da chuva.
sentences.en: They took the subway and got to the museum before the rain.

sentences.pt: Lá, eles viram uma exposição muito colorida.
sentences.en: There, they saw a very colorful exhibition.

sentences.pt: Os quadros tinham flores vermelhas, céus azuis e praias douradas.
sentences.en: The pictures had red flowers, blue skies and golden beaches.

sentences.pt: Larissa gostou de um quadro com um mar verde e um sol laranja.
sentences.en: Larissa liked a picture with a green sea and an orange sun.

sentences.pt: Enquanto eles olhavam os quadros, começou a chover muito.
sentences.en: While they were looking at the pictures, it started to rain hard.

sentences.pt: Eles ouviram trovões e viram relâmpagos pela janela.
sentences.en: They heard thunder and saw lightning through the window.

sentences.pt: Depois de uma hora, a tempestade passou.
sentences.en: After an hour, the storm passed.

sentences.pt: Quando eles saíram, a rua estava molhada e o ar estava frio.
sentences.en: When they left, the street was wet and the air was cold.

sentences.pt: Mas o sol voltou entre as nuvens.
sentences.en: But the sun came back between the clouds.

sentences.pt: No fim da tarde, o céu ficou claro e rosa.
sentences.en: At the end of the afternoon, the sky turned bright and pink.

sentences.pt: Diego tirou uma foto de Larissa na calçada.
sentences.en: Diego took a photo of Larissa on the sidewalk.

sentences.pt: "No fim, foi um dia lindo", disse ela.
sentences.en: "In the end, it was a beautiful day," she said.

sentences.pt: "Com chuva ou com sol, eu adoro passear com você", respondeu Diego.
sentences.en: "Rain or shine, I love going out with you," answered Diego.

questions.q: Como estava o céu no sábado de manhã?
questions.qEn: What was the sky like on Saturday morning?

questions.q: Onde Larissa e Diego passaram a tarde?
questions.qEn: Where did Larissa and Diego spend the afternoon?

questions.q: Como estava a rua depois da tempestade?
questions.qEn: What was the street like after the storm?

sentences.pt: Gustavo mora em Fortaleza, onde faz calor o ano todo.
sentences.en: Gustavo lives in Fortaleza, where it's hot all year.

sentences.pt: Em julho, ele foi visitar a prima Aline em Porto Alegre.
sentences.en: In July, he went to visit his cousin Aline in Porto Alegre.

sentences.pt: No avião, ele estava animado, mas também um pouco preocupado.
sentences.en: On the plane, he was excited, but also a little worried.

sentences.pt: "No sul, o inverno é muito frio", Aline disse no telefone.
sentences.en: "In the south, winter is very cold," Aline said on the phone.

sentences.pt: Quando Gustavo chegou, a temperatura era de 8 graus.
sentences.en: When Gustavo arrived, the temperature was 8 degrees.

sentences.pt: Ele só tinha roupas leves e uma calça fina.
sentences.en: He only had light clothes and thin pants.

sentences.pt: Aline riu e emprestou roupas quentes do irmão dela.
sentences.en: Aline laughed and lent him warm clothes from her brother.

sentences.pt: Na primeira manhã, a cidade estava com neblina.
sentences.en: On the first morning, the city was foggy.

sentences.pt: Gustavo não conseguia ver os prédios do outro lado da rua.
sentences.en: Gustavo couldn't see the buildings on the other side of the street.

sentences.pt: À tarde, ventou muito e o céu ficou cinza.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, it was very windy and the sky turned gray.

sentences.pt: Gustavo ficou em casa e tomou chá quente o dia todo.
sentences.en: Gustavo stayed home and drank hot tea all day.

sentences.pt: No terceiro dia, o tempo mudou.
sentences.en: On the third day, the weather changed.

sentences.pt: O céu ficou azul e claro, sem nenhuma nuvem.
sentences.en: The sky turned blue and clear, without a single cloud.

sentences.pt: Ainda estava frio, mas o sol era lindo e dourado.
sentences.en: It was still cold, but the sun was beautiful and golden.

sentences.pt: Os dois passearam no centro e viram árvores com folhas amarelas e marrons.
sentences.en: The two of them strolled downtown and saw trees with yellow and brown leaves.

sentences.pt: "Aqui o inverno é diferente, mas é bonito", disse Gustavo.
sentences.en: "Winter here is different, but it's pretty," said Gustavo.

sentences.pt: Quando voltou para Fortaleza, ele sentiu calor no aeroporto.
sentences.en: When he went back to Fortaleza, he felt hot at the airport.

sentences.pt: Ele tirou a roupa quente e riu.
sentences.en: He took off the warm clothes and laughed.

sentences.pt: "Agora eu tenho saudade do frio!", ele escreveu numa mensagem para Aline.
sentences.en: "Now I miss the cold!" he wrote in a message to Aline.

questions.q: Onde mora a prima do Gustavo?
Como estava a cidade na primeira manhã?
questions.qEn: What was the city like on the first morning?
When did the sky turn blue?
